description: Parity 14.2 real-device records of the Windows maintenance tasks (Windows 11 Enterprise 10.0.26200 x64). Every first-wave task has a real run record.

elevation.pending: The UAC launcher (ShellExecuteExW runas) was not exercised: the shell was already elevated and tests never prompt. The worker protocol, pipe DACL and PID checks are exercised with an unelevated child (crates/cm-cli/tests/optimize_flow.rs) and in-process (crates/cm-platform/src/windows/elevation/tests.rs).

findings: windows.shell-restart: on this device StartMenuExperienceHost and SearchHost refuse a graceful Restart Manager close, so the task ends as attention (did_not_close) and the user is told to sign out and back in. Forcing termination is outside the D10 contract.
windows.icon-cache-rebuild: Explorer keeps 11 cache files open while signed in; only unused files are removed (attention partly_in_use).
